bull.b: The turnaround to positive earnings and strong operating margins indicates that commercial revenue can support the cost base. If maintained, this profitability provides internal funding for pipeline development and greater resilience than the company’s prior loss-making profile.

A cash-rich, debt-free balance sheet gives Protalix flexibility to fund operations, clinical development and manufacturing without immediate refinancing pressure. This financial position can help preserve strategic options while programs advance and reduce exposure to interest or covenant constraints.

Growing Elfabrio sales alongside broader geographic and dosing approvals supports a durable commercial platform rather than relying solely on early-stage pipeline value. Expanded access can improve adoption and strengthen the product’s position in the global Fabry market over coming quarters.

bear.b: Dependence on Chiesi purchasing and inventory decisions makes reported revenue timing less predictable, even when underlying demand is stable. This variability can complicate forecasting, reduce confidence in quarterly comparisons, and make resource planning more difficult over the next several periods.

The large milestone materially boosted first-half results but is not expected to recur on the same basis. Comparisons that include this payment may overstate the underlying run rate, leaving future growth and profitability more dependent on recurring product sales and partner activity.

The observed immunogenicity rate and unresolved dosing choice create meaningful execution risk for PRX-115. The program may require regimen trade-offs between efficacy, antibodies and infusion reactions, potentially affecting development timing, trial design and eventual market positioning.
